description.en: A DeepSeek coding agent harness: persistent shell, Ultra subagents, auto approval, Chrome MCP and session telemetry
dsh-sd-bridge-guard插件已发布，可以帮你完善提示词，提高图片质量，并做到dsh无限制生图

Zotero library tools via the local API (no API key, Zotero 7+): search items and collections, read metadata, abstracts and PDF full text (on-the-fly parsing when the cache misses), download attachments, and manage notes; API endpoint, target library and limits are configurable.
description.zh: 通过 Zotero 本地 API（无需 API Key，Zotero 7+）操作文献库：检索条目与分类、读元数据/摘要/PDF 全文（缓存未命中时现场解析）、下载附件、管理笔记；API 地址、目标文献库与限额均可配置。

description.en: DSH 远程目录（手机端）：在选文件夹流程里多出「电脑」页签，进入电脑目录、在电脑上发起对话，并把电脑的实时消息流同步到手机本地界面（只传文本，不映射桌面）。

Tieba (Baidu forum) reader and companion for DSH: reads threads, writes daily digests, signs in, and builds a per-forum style library from high-liked replies. Optional replies to threads or to sub-replies under your own comments are off by default and limited per round and per day. Also ships a read-only MCP server for Codex, AstrBot and Claude Desktop.
description.zh: DSH 泡贴吧插件：读帖、写日报、签到，并从高赞回复里按吧建立风格库；回帖与楼中楼默认关闭，受每轮/每日限额。另带只读 MCP server，可接 Codex、AstrBot、Claude Desktop。

description.en: Rust-based POSIX bash executor for the Windows platform — gives DSH a native bash with no WSL or MSYS compatibility layer, honors DSH's three-tier permission policy, and provides persistent-terminal tools.
description.zh: Rust 实现的 Windows 平台 POSIX bash 执行器：为 DSH 提供原生 bash（不依赖 WSL 或 MSYS兼容层），服从 DSH 的三档权限策略、提供持久化终端工具。

description.en: Newmark Core for DeepSeek Harness：MemoryLab、ComputerUse、Agent API、NewMate 陪伴内核与 heartBeat 重启投递，五个独立开关，共用 ~/.Newmark 用户库。
一个个人的知识库，它可以记录你的性格、做事方式和你所有的资料，并帮你有序的归档整理，并带有一个专门用于管理与对话的Agent。你可以随时向他提问，查资料等等，它会根据你的习惯与你规定的方式进行回答。你能够掌握全局资料给你更好更全面的答复与建议。
description.zh: 把你的性格、习惯和资料都记下来，自动归档整理，还能随时问它查资料、给建议。

description.en: Remote monitoring and guidance for DSH agents — a Cordis plugin for macOS/Windows plus a Swift-native iOS/iPad app.
description.zh: 用手机远程查看 DSH Agent 的工作状态，还能发消息、处理审批，出门在外也不耽误。

description.en: Three DSH tools that let any agent — including a team member — list, steer and stop the subagents it started.
description.zh: 让任意 DSH 智能体（包括团队成员）查看、指挥并叫停自己启动的子智能体。

description.en: Find keywords in the current conversation or across every session, with highlight and jump.
description.zh: 在当前对话或所有会话里按关键词查找，命中可高亮、可跳转。

description.en: Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness: questions, approvals, turn summaries, subagent notifications and a loopback control panel.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的提问、审批、回合总结和子代理通知转发到 Telegram，还能用本地控制面板远程盯着。

description.en: Keeps the PTC run_code deadline from firing while DSH waits for your answer, plan review or approval, so a question can stay open longer than the shipped 120 s budget.
description.zh: 把 PTC 模式 run_code 的执行预算在人机等待期间暂停，提问、计划审议或审批可以超过出厂的 120 秒而不被中断。

description.en: 原版乔木 UI 学习的 DeepSeek Harness 迁移版：13561 设计参考、106 交互标本、审美测验与 Markdown 学习笔记
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里逛设计图库、学 UI 词汇、练审美，点评还能存成 Markdown 笔记。

description.en: Adjust Agent Team's member count, task count, message size and teardown timeout.
description.zh: 调整 Agent Team 的人数、任务数、单条消息大小与清理超时。

description.en: DSH 远程目录（电脑端）：把本机 DSH 会话的事件流经 Cloudflare 隧道搬到手机，手机进入电脑目录并发起对话，公网只传文本。含激活码配对流程。
按物理像素截屏的 DSH 插件 | Native-pixel screenshots for DSH
description.zh: 按物理像素截屏和录屏，画面清晰不糊，适合演示和素材收集。

description.en: A writable, git-versioned self for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): persona files injected every turn, gated self-editing, journal→dream reflection, and a Settings › 人格 tab.
description.zh: 给 dsh 装一个可写、带 git 版本的人格：每轮注入人设，可受控自改，日记沉淀成梦境反思。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: lightweight Windows desktop control (screenshot + OCR + UIA) with content policy and action verification. Fork of qingying012/dsh-desktop-control (MIT).
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 能安全地操控 Windows 桌面，截图、OCR 识别界面，操作前先过内容策略、做完再验证结果。

description.en: Hierarchical workspace tree plus browser-style session tabs for the DSH sidebar: a "/" in a workspace or session title creates a virtual folder, with sections, pinning, time buckets, drag ordering, unified 6px status dots, per-row appearance customization (colour, glow, weight, icon) and a floating full-text search over session titles and message bodies. Several settings switches restore any behaviour to the host default, and a host-side route deletes sessions permanently (DSH ships archive only). Fork of KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的工作区层级树与浏览器式会话标签页：工作区或会话标题中的 / 自动成为虚拟分组，另含分区、置顶、时间分桶、拖拽排序、统一 6px 状态点、按行定制外观（颜色 / 发光 / 字重 / 图标），以及覆盖会话标题与消息正文的浮层全文检索。配置页多个开关可把任一行为还原为宿主默认；宿主侧另有永久删除会话的路由（DSH 只有归档）。fork 自 KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace。

description.en: Adds a "Compact and run" action to the DSH Web plan-review card, which compacts the history submitted before the plan into a checkpoint and then approves the plan.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的计划审批卡上增加「压缩后执行」：先把计划提交之前的历史压成检查点，再批准计划。

description.en: DSH web plugin (dsh-better-sidebar companion): export the current .md file to standalone HTML (Mermaid inlined) or PDF - export button on the markdown toolbar
Native workbench to select project sources, distill and test capability candidates, configure scoped Slack access, and review approvals and persistent tasks.
description.zh: 原生分身工作台：选择项目资料、蒸馏并试跑能力候选、配置有范围的 Slack 访问，查看审批与持久任务。

description.en: 更好的Goal实现 | Better goal tool for DSH
description.zh: 替换原生 goal，让目标自动续跑，该停就停、该问就问，操作更省心。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible HTTP surface for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): POST /v1/chat/completions, POST /v1/responses, GET /v1/models over the harness webServer + llm runtime
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 套上 OpenAI 兼容接口，现有 OpenAI 客户端改个地址就能直接调用 DSH 智能体会话。

description.en: ChatGPT plan connection for DeepSeek Harness through Sign in with ChatGPT      通过官方接口将你的ChatGPT订阅接入dsh使用
description.zh: 用 ChatGPT 账号授权登录，把 ChatGPT 订阅接入 DSH，支持文字、图片、工具调用和多账号。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 进度汇报提醒插件：累计每 N 步或每 N 秒提醒 Agent 汇报一次进度，侧栏实时显示计数，聊天区横幅显示上次提醒时刻。附带余额低额提醒与 DeepSeek 峰谷时段指示。
description.zh: 长回合里定时提醒 Agent 汇报进度，侧栏看计数、横幅看上次提醒，还能盯余额和峰谷时段。

description.en: Persistent task supervision with plan coverage review, DAG progress, sidebar consultation, and stage/completion checks; npm development preview.
description.zh: 给 DSH 任务加上计划审核、进度追踪和完成检查，让长任务跑得更稳更可控。

description.en: A Neon Genesis Evangelion-inspired skin for DeepSeek Harness: Title Card (light) and Central Dogma (dark) modes over one removable override layer, 55 measured color tokens, a wallpaper paint layer whose two surface alphas are solved against a WCAG contrast budget, a boot mask and a brand mark. It also rewrites the sidebar identity line, replaces the new-session heading, hides six official entries, and reshapes the composer control row. Unofficial fan work, non-commercial: the background pictures are fetched from third-party URLs at paint time, not shipped in the repository.
description.zh: 基于《新世纪福音战士》的 DeepSeek Harness 皮肤：Title Card（亮色）与 Central Dogma（暗色）两套完整模式叠在一层可移除的覆盖层上，55 个实测色值，壁纸绘制层的两个表面 alpha 按 WCAG 对比度预算求解，另有开机遮罩与品牌标记。它还改写侧栏身份行、替换新会话页的标题、隐藏六处官方入口，并重排会话框控件行。非官方同人作品、非商业用途：背景图在绘制时从第三方 URL 拉取，不随仓库分发。

description.en: 把 agent-skills 的 git-kit Git 工作流、handoff 跨会话交接与 disk-cleanup 磁盘清理以 dsh 原生斜杠命令接入（薄意图表，委托对应 skill 执行）

Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a ~600-character hot layer that evicts its own overflow, month-archived cold entries recalled by keyword and ranked by usage, and extractive day/week/month summaries.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的分层长期记忆：热层约 600 字、超限自动腾挪，冷层按月归档、可按关键词跨月召回并按使用度排序，日/周/月三级抽取式摘要控制注入体量。

description.en: 思考小窗：贴边深呼吸箭头、思考增量翻译；设置页可选官方 Bing/Google/DeepSeek 或自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点，支持拉取模型列表与连接测试，本地端点走宿时代理绕过 CORS。
MoonPet（月伴）：DeepSeek Harness 状态宠物、番茄钟、多语言字幕与可选励志语音。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里养一只会跟着你思考、工作和休息的桌面宠物，还带番茄钟和字幕语音。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在侧边栏实时查看阿里云「云工开物」学生专属 300 元代金券余额。零 Token 消耗（本机无头浏览器直连阿里云费用控制台抓取，不走大模型），1–30 分钟自动刷新，深浅色跟随 DSH 原生主题。Windows / macOS / Linux。
description.zh: 在侧边栏随时查看阿里云学生 300 元代金券余额，本机抓取不耗 Token，自动刷新。

description.en: AntV AVA plugin for DeepSeek Harness with streaming narrative text and charts
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接展示数据结论和图表，支持流式叙述文字，还能上传文件协作。

description.en: Personas, memory and opt-in proactive chat that resumes after restart for DeepSeek Harness Desktop. 社区预发布插件：白饭鱼女儿、角色记忆与重启恢复主动聊天。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版加个有记忆、能换人设、还会主动找你聊天的 AI 伙伴，重启也不失忆。

description.en: 让大肥鱼在 DSH 中长期生活：自主刷 B 站、互动、长期记忆、成长、好友关系与完整经历持久化。
description.zh: 让大肥鱼在 DSH 里长期生活：自己刷 B 站、交朋友、记经历，还会回主会话跟你聊天。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 开屏动画（二次改造版）：H.D.D. SYSTEM 伪开机动画 + FAIRY 徽记（徽记可拖动，双击归位）+ 自定义左下角头像/昵称。素材与灵感来自 B站 @_天才小宇
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端加一段 14.5 秒伪开机开屏动画，配可拖动的 FAIRY 徽记和自定义头像昵称。

description.en: dsh自主资讯推送插件，采集资讯后自主推送会话
description.zh: 自动搜集你关心的资讯并主动推送到会话，还能用系统弹窗提醒会话状态。

description.en: Publishes the running DSH host as a Model Context Protocol endpoint, so other harnesses such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or another DSH can start and continue sessions, read transcripts, wait on or cancel turns, and answer pending approvals; every call is attributed to its caller, and owner-scoped sessions keep callers apart.
description.zh: 把正在运行的 DSH 宿主发布成 MCP 端点，让 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、另一个 DSH 等 harness 可以创建与延续会话、读取对话记录、等待或取消回合、代答待决审批；每次调用都归因到发起方，会话按所有者隔离。
每天21点从网易云每日推荐挑5首试听30秒，DeepSeek选3首写推荐理由发到对话里。

description.en: Session plugins, MCP servers and skills panel for DeepSeek Harness: a top-right header popover with per-item enable switches and session plugin usage.
description.zh: 会话标题栏右上角一键展开，查看当前会话用到的插件、MCP 服务和技能，还能随手开关。

description.en: Live CNY cost of the current session in the DSH composer dock, with editable per-model rate cards.
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时显示当前会话花了多少人民币，还能按模型改单价、看峰谷时段明细。

description.en: Ultracode for DeepSeek Harness: dynamic standard-preset inheritance, bounded multi-agent workflows, floating progress viewer, and subtle composer glow.
ForeSight: a temporal-aspect long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上带时间维度的长期记忆，让 AI 记得住过去的事，聊得越久越懂你。

description.en: Adds a stamina-bar desktop pet to every DeepSeek Harness session — two bars in the session header for context and alertness, plus a draggable whale-girl who can be poked, petted and dressed up.
description.zh: 给 DSH 每个会话加一只体力条桌宠：会话头部显示上下文与清醒度两条，点一下就能把她放到桌面上，可以拖动、戳、摸头、换装。

description.en: An Astra Yao desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI that renders the Codex v2 8x11 sprite atlas, follows session state through thinking, running, waiting and failed, shows a status bubble with the running tool and a DeepSeek balance readout (on by default, can be switched off), and quotes her own voice lines while idle.
description.zh: 把 Astra Yao（耀嘉音）的 Codex 桌宠图集搬进 DSH Web 界面：随会话状态切换到构思、执行、候场、破音等动作，头顶气泡显示正在跑的工具和余额（默认开启，可关），空闲时轮播她的官方台词。

description.en: Long-term memory scoped to the DSH workspace. A session opens with a one-line-per-memory index - bodies are fetched on demand by the `memory` tool, so the same character budget holds about three times as many entries - and when a turn ends a purely local search over the last user message pulls the matching memories into the next briefing at no model cost. Optional auto-capture distils a stretch of conversation into structured memories; in draft mode they wait in an approval queue instead of landing directly. A portrait layer keeps a workspace and a global picture, rewritten from the journal and the records, with the same draft-or-direct choice. Settings → Memory holds the archive, list and timeline views, a health check (duplicate clusters, stale entries, broken links), the supersede version chain with rollback, and a read-only scan that imports existing WorkBuddy / Qoder memory files.
description.zh: DSH 的工作区长期记忆。会话开始只注入「一行一条」的记忆索引，正文由 memory 工具按需取——同样字数预算约装三倍条目；一轮结束时用当轮最后一条用户消息做纯本地检索，命中的记忆下一轮随简报召回，不花模型 token。可选自动提炼把一段对话归纳成结构化记忆，captureMode=draft 时先进审批队列、你批准了才生效。另有画像层：工作区与全局各一份全貌，由日志与条目重写生成，同样可走草稿。设置 → 记忆 里有档案 / 列表 / 时间线、体检（重复簇、过期未用、断链）、版本链 supersede 与一键回滚，以及「扫描本机」把已有的 WorkBuddy / Qoder 记忆文件导入（只读，不动来源）。

description.en: Answers what the voice model delegates by admitting a turn to a DeepSeek Harness session and speaking the agent's reply.

Evidence-backed UI delivery for coding agents working on existing Web products: declared criteria, criterion-bound artifacts, findings linked to declarations, and repair guidance. Evaluator review does not replace human semantic approval.
Hybrid model router for DeepSeek Harness: declarative rules, user-configurable cost control (cost-first / quality-first / balanced), optional LLM task classifier, and failure fallback chains.
起诉状要素齐备性核对（按诉请、事实、证据、法条四要素核对文书齐备，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 帮你逐项核对起诉状或申请书要素是否齐全，事实、证据、法律依据、金额一个都不漏。

Douyin (抖音) automation for DeepSeek Harness: watch private messages and wake the agent event-driven, plus 10 tools (read DM, send DM, comment, @ mention, reply, delete comment, read notice, share video card, pick feed candidates, cookie backup/restore) —

DSH 循环护栏：① assistant-stream 字符重复检测（可 abort）；①b 低多样性高重复（末窗 + 滑窗两支，抓「带噪声的交替空转」与「正常推理里夹一段空转」——① 线的精确匹配结构上抓不到它们）；①c ① 线命中时注入「停止」类词 + 预注册观测（注入是温和动作，先于掐断）；② 行动层「无进展」停滞检测；②b 同参工具调用连击（按**动作参数**判定，忽略 description 之类自注）；③ 反复卡住达阈值 ⇒ agent.cancel() 真切断；⑤ 零正文 turn（只有思考

dsh Web UI 微调合集：回合尾「本回合改动」卡在会话释放后仍按官方样式显示（用会话日志重建数据喂给官方卡）、宽表格越界修复、对话区左侧自绘滚动条、动画修复、插件更新检查面板、桌面端窗口记忆（不含 dsh 本体）
Verified restart for DeepSeek Harness: restart without privileges, check that the harness really came back, report the verdict to the session that asked, and hand back what was left to do.
description.zh: 重启 DeepSeek Harness 后自动确认恢复状态并交接会话，让重启真正可靠。

description.en: 信用证单据条款核对（按单据种类、份数、期限与不符点核对交单自洽，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 帮你逐条核对信用证交单的单据类型和条款要求，快速查出不符点。

description.en: 法条引用与文书要素核对（按名称、条号、原文与效力状态核对引用可核验性，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 检查法条引用清单是否规范可查，逐条核对法律名称、条文序号和引用格式。

description.en: Connects the hosted Knowra MCP server: search arXiv papers by topic, author or exact UTC dates without an account, and sign in with OAuth from the plugin page to read Scout reports on methods, evidence and limitations.
description.zh: 接入 Knowra 托管 MCP：无需账号即可按主题、作者或精确 UTC 日期检索 arXiv 论文；在插件页用 OAuth 登录后可读取 Scout 报告（方法、证据与局限）。

description.zh: 面向自选资料的学习陪练，使用当前 DSH 会话模型，提供引导练习、证据反馈、Leitner 间隔复习、18 个教师工具与中英双语学生面板；要求 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0、Python 3.11+ 及 Python 运行时依赖。

description.zh: 在消息输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek API 余额和当前计费时段，帮你随时掌握用量和花费。

description.en: 在线点评回复台账核对（按回复时限、问题分类与整改状态核对台账闭环，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 核对 OTA 点评与回复登记表的完整性，只标出差异，不下定性结论。

description.en: Adds a comet-like light band that flows along the window edge of DeepSeek Harness — up to four in parallel, colored by each session's model, reversing direction while waiting for your reply, and returning to the composer or the workspace once the conversation ends.
description.zh: 为你的 DeepSeek Harness 添加沿窗口边缘流动的流星式光带 —— 最多四条并行、按会话模型配色、等待回复时反向流动，在对话结束后自行返回对话框或工作区。

description.en: Enter-plan-mode tool: gives the model a callable `dsh_enter_plan_mode_enter_plan_mode` that switches the current session into plan mode, pairing with the built-in `exit_plan_mode` for a plan-then-review loop.
description.zh: 进入计划模式工具：给模型一个可调用的 `dsh_enter_plan_mode_enter_plan_mode`，把当前会话切进计划模式，与内置的 `exit_plan_mode` 配对，形成“先规划、后评审”的闭环。

description.en: GPT-Live-1 full-duplex voice adapter for the dsh-realtime seam, over the OpenAI Live WebSocket API.
Local-first long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: text packages, on-demand recall, raw event citation, multiple brains and workspace boundaries.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH 长期记忆插件：文本包、按需检索、可回原始事件、多大脑与工作区边界。

description.en: Generate images and videos, edit images, remove backgrounds, upscale images, upload reference media, and check Fotor credits.
description.zh: 通过 Fotor 生成图片和视频、编辑图片、移除背景、放大图片、上传参考素材及查询积分。

description.en: Right-click a file link in the transcript: quote it into the composer as the same reference chip a drag-drop produces, or reveal the file in the OS file manager. The menu is drawn in the app's own style, not the system one.
description.zh: 对话里的文件路径右键就有动作：引用回输入框时插成和拖文件一样的引用芯片，或在文件管理器里直接选中。菜单跟着 App 的深浅色走，不是系统弹窗。

description.en: Whole-disk file search tool backed by the local Everything (voidtools) index: millisecond path queries for the agent over a loopback-only HTTP fast channel with es.exe fallback, plus verified auto-install of the latest stable Everything + ES CLI backend (signature-checked, proxy-aware). Windows only.
description.zh: 基于本机 Everything（voidtools）索引的全盘文件搜索工具：通过仅回环监听的 HTTP 快速通道（es.exe 兜底）为 Agent 提供毫秒级路径查询；后端缺失时自动下载并校验安装最新稳定版 Everything 与 ES CLI（验签名、支持代理）。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Adds backup-then-delete and delete-only actions to the DSH session menu: the session directory, its projection cache and a metadata snapshot are copied to a local archive folder and checked file by file, then the originals are deleted to free disk space; subagent sessions it spawned are handled in the same run, and each backup folder keeps a RESTORE.txt with recovery steps.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话「…」菜单加「备份删除」与「彻底删除」两个入口：先把会话目录、投影缓存和元数据快照复制到本地归档文件夹并逐文件校验，通过后再删除原件以释放磁盘空间；派生的子代理会话一并处理，每个备份文件夹都带 RESTORE.txt 恢复步骤。

description.en: DSH Pixel Team - a pixel cultivation hall for DeepSeek Harness multi-agent teams: durable members, dependency-aware tasks, quality gates and 15 realms. MIT, local-first.
description.zh: 给多 Agent 团队搭一个像素风修炼大厅，成员、任务依赖、质量关卡和十五重境界都能管。

description.en: Scans a repository when a Harness agent starts working in it and, if more than a fifth of it is build output, lockfiles and logs, injects a note naming the largest offenders plus an .aiignore block that cuts them. Stays silent on clean repositories.
description.zh: 在 Harness agent 开始处理某个仓库时扫描一次；若超过五分之一的体积是构建产物、锁文件和日志，就注入一条提示，点名最占空间的几项并给出一段可直接使用的 .aiignore；仓库干净则不打扰。

description.en: Using Ai tools to finish my daily work report
description.zh: 把本机 AI 编程和聊天记录按项目归好类，自动整理成日报周报，数据不出本地。

description.en: Unofficial DSH port of ARS academic-paper-reviewer (Phase 1: reviewer only). CC BY-NC 4.0 - non-commercial.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里给学术论文做同行评审，帮你快速审稿、挑毛病、提修改意见。

description.en: Evolvable Markdown playbook for DSH agents — retrospectives distill lessons, consulted before tasks.
description.zh: 给 DSH agent 装上一本会自己进化的 Markdown 操作手册，任务后自动复盘攒经验，下次干活前先翻手册。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 多 Agent 协作插件（Agent Team Room）：独立页面、人工/主 Agent 自动组队、持续到交付的协作循环与交付判定。
description.zh: 在独立页面里给多个 Agent 组队派活，看它们协作干活直到交付，主 Agent 自动判定完成。

description.en: AI-generated session titles for DeepSeek Harness: one-click generate inside the session rename dialog.
description.zh: 在会话重命名弹窗里一键让 AI 根据真实对话内容生成简短标题，省去手动起名。

description.en: DSH 侧边栏插件：把归档会话列成一屏，勾选后批量删除。
description.zh: 把归档会话集中列在一屏，勾选后批量删除，清理起来更省事。

description.en: Brave Search provider for DeepSeek Harness: one backend, no settings UI, key from the credential store.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接上 Brave 网页搜索，查资料、找答案直接出结果，不用配任何设置。

description.en: Fix CodeBuddy (Tencent) channel returning HTTP 400 Illegal API invocation from an unapproved channel in DeepSeek Harness by prefixing a space to the system prompt.
description.zh: 给系统提示词前面加个空格，就能修好 CodeBuddy 频道一直报 HTTP 400 被拦截的问题。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：聊天输入框可自由拖动调整高度，默认上限 168px，双击复位 · Resizable composer height for DSH
description.zh: 给 DSH 聊天输入框加个拖动把手，高度随手调，双击就能复位，不再长到半屏。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness gate - per-turn persistent-operation counter: remind, instruct the model to stop, then ask for confirmation. Steps aside under sandbox/read-only modes; follows a live permission switch without restart. Verified on real hardware (full -> workspace-write -> read-only -> full). Crafted on an estimated 0.27 USD of model spend.
description.zh: 给 AI 代理加个操作确认闸，连续执行危险操作时先提醒、再叫停、最后要你点头，防止权限放开后失控。

description.en: Export a DSH session's complete model chain-of-thought to Markdown / JSON / JSONL / text, and prepare supervised review packages for other agents.
description.zh: 一键把 DSH 会话里模型的完整思维链导出成 Markdown、JSON、JSONL 或纯文本，还能打包成给其他 agent 审查的监督包。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that makes your cursor more fluid, leaving a glowing trail as you move.
description.zh: 把系统指针换成 DeepSeek 蓝色圆点，带呼吸光晕和拖尾，让鼠标移动更有质感。

description.en: Decision 3.0 multimodal decision models for DeepSeek Harness: calibrated-probability agent tools (choice/noul/score/box), a Settings page, and a probability-bar card.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上多模态决策模型，用校准概率的智能体工具做选择、打分和框选，还带设置页和概率条卡片。

description.en: 住在自己手机上的角色，DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件：自带 Android 手机、她自己的 QQ、来自真实事件的记忆与日记、两次对话之间的生活（幕间）、可选 VM 电脑。A character who lives on her own phone, for DSH.
description.zh: 把 dsh 变成常驻在线的个人 AI 助手，自带电脑，能通过微信等 IM 找到它，还能定时干活、限制预算。

description.en: Owner workbench for independently connected family WeChat assistants, per-member project and tool permissions, scheduled services and delivery status; API acceptance does not confirm receipt.
description.zh: 通过 Owner 工作台管理家人各自连接的微信助手、按人授予项目和工具权限、安排服务并查看投递状态；接口接受不代表手机实收。

description.en: 肥鱼电台 FishFM — 给 DeepSeek 大肥鱼一副耳机。面向 DeepSeek Harness 的音乐人格与桌面伴侣，规划支持网易云和 QQ 音乐。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个音乐电台，导入你常听的歌，让网易云推荐、模型挑歌单，干活时自动放歌。

description.en: Captures and compares single-token behavioral fingerprints of configured DSH model routes using the One Token Is Enough protocol.
description.zh: 使用《One Token Is Enough》论文协议，对 DSH 已配置的模型路由采集并比较单 token 行为指纹。

description.en: Cinematic 3D galaxy view for DeepSeek Harness — workspaces as suns, conversations as stars, plus a memory library and an armillary sphere. · DSH 三维星系图插件
description.zh: 把工作区和对话画成可旋转缩放的三维星系，点星就能跳进对话，还能看记忆库和浑天仪。

description.en: 把自有订阅凭证在本机转成 OpenAI 兼容接口的 DSH 插件；非官方项目，与任何上游服务无关联，仅供个人学习研究。
description.zh: 把自有订阅凭证在本机转成 OpenAI 兼容接口，方便个人学习研究调用。

description.en: DSH 主动心跳插件：定时醒来，自己判断要不要主动找主人说句话（独立内心会话 + 设置页 + OneBot/QQ）
description.zh: 定时自动醒来，自己判断要不要主动找你聊两句，还能通过 QQ 发消息。

description.en: Sync DSH profiles, plugin manifests, and skills between Macs through iCloud Drive.
description.zh: 通过 iCloud Drive 在多台 Mac 之间同步 DSH 配置、插件清单和技能，让各设备环境保持一致。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 生图插件：本地参考库 + 关键词 + 图片/文字转三视图，模型按情境自己判断发什么图
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个会看场合发图的生图工具，靠本地参考库保证角色和设定一致。

description.en: Lead mode for DSH: an agent preset, a working-method skill, a dependency self-check, and two reminders that tell you to enable the official Agent Teams. | 给 DSH 加 Lead 模式：预设、skill、依赖自检、两条前置提醒。
description.zh: 装上就多一个 Lead 模式预设和技能，让模型按拆活、派活、验收的方式干活，没开 Agent Teams 还会提醒你。

description.en: Session-level lesson ledger watch for DeepSeek Harness: did this session actually consult the ledger and record its pitfalls?
description.zh: 盯住当前会话有没有真的查经验账本、记下踩过的坑，顺手显示规则库健康度。

description.en: Drive DSH's own sidebar browser: real webview rendering plus an injected command surface so the agent can click, type, read and scroll the page the human is looking at.
description.zh: 让 AI 直接操作 DSH 侧边栏浏览器，点击、输入、滚动、读取你正在看的网页。

description.en: Git tab in the DSH web UI right sidebar for the current session repository — switches branches from a dropdown of local and remote branches (with ahead/behind counts), stages files in staged/unstaged/untracked/conflicted groups, commits, fetches, pulls and pushes with automatic upstream setup, drafts a Conventional Commits message from the staged diff with the default model and falls back to a plain chore message when none is available, and renders git log --graph with per-branch colors plus a word-level highlighted diff.
description.zh: DSH Web 右侧边栏的 Git tab，跟随当前会话的仓库：下拉切换本地/远程分支（带 ahead/behind），按 staged/unstaged/untracked/conflicted 分组暂存，提交、fetch、pull、push（无 upstream 时自动建跟踪分支），用默认模型按已暂存 diff 起草约定式提交信息（模型不可用时降级为普通 chore 文案），并以每条分支一种颜色的形式渲染 git log --graph 和词级高亮的 diff。

description.en: 「DSH 冷启动开场动画插件：视频 / 图片 / 幻灯片」
description.zh: 给 DSH 冷启动加个全屏开场动画，视频、图片、幻灯片都能放，还能自己导入素材。

description.en: 基于DeepSeek Harness 的 Overleaf Workshop 插件：三栏工作区、实时同步
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接编辑 Overleaf 项目，三栏布局加实时双向同步，写 LaTeX 更顺手。

description.en: DSH Pixel Team - a pixel cultivation hall for DeepSeek Harness multi-agent teams: durable members, dependency-aware tasks, quality gates and 15 realms. MIT, local-first.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 多智能体团队搭一个像素风协作大厅，成员、任务、质量关卡和境界成长都管起来。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness session deletion plugin with a five-second restore window
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话菜单加个删除按钮，误删后 5 秒内还能恢复，过期就永久删除。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that reports the time you spend coding with AI to WakaTime as `ai coding` heartbeats.
description.zh: 把你在 DeepSeek Harness 里用 AI 写代码的时间，自动上报到 WakaTime 记成 ai coding。

description.en: DSH Project Hub - a DeepSeek Harness plugin: projects, two-tier tag archives, isolated sub-workspaces and AI sessions in one handover-ready workflow.
description.zh: 把项目、标签档案、子工作区和 AI 会话串成一条能直接交接的工作流，省去来回整理。

description.en: Market-gap radar for DSH plugin developers. Splits the catalog into categories and topics, tags every topic empty, thin, contested or crowded, and ranks the emptiest directions first, so you know what to build before writing it; it also browses the whole market with copy-ready install commands.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件开发者的市场空白雷达。把目录拆到大类与方向，每档标出空位、稀少、有竞争或红海，空位最多的方向排在前面，动手前先知道该做什么；同时可浏览整个市场并一键复制安装命令。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3 破甲/清理插件（dsh-purge 分支）：82 条补丁、逐字节可回滚备份、灵魂闸门、31 条单元测试 | DSH jailbreak + patch/uninstall toolkit for 0.2.1-rc.3
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3 打补丁、破甲并支持逐字节回滚的清理工具，自带 31 条单元测试。
改完插件代码点一下就能生效，不用重启 DSH，开发调试省心多了。

description.en: 在 DSH 网页版「设置 → 通用」加入进程控制行：手动重启 dsh web 宿主进程，以及「跟随系统启动」勾选框（写入 macOS launchd / Linux systemd / Windows 服务自启条目，开机拉起并在崩溃后自动重启）。
description.zh: 在设置里一键重启 dsh web 进程，还能勾选开机自启，崩溃后自动拉起。

description.en: DSH插件：回退某一轮，然后开新分支继续，而不是把工作丢掉。  每轮回答的尾部有一个动作——**回到这轮提问前**。它把该轮通过 DSH 文件工具改过的文件恢复到提问之前，再从这条消息的边界 fork 出一个新分支会话并切过去；来源会话保持原样。
description.zh: 回退某一轮对话并恢复该轮改过的文件，再从原处开新分支继续，原会话不受影响。

description.en: 把 DSH 会话一键导出成可读的 Markdown / Export a DeepSeek Harness session as readable Markdown, dialogue only.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话一键导出成干净好读的 Markdown 文件，只保留对话内容，不带工具调用杂讯。

description.en: Shared Memory（AI 跨平台记忆增强）— cross-session, cross-app memory for DeepSeek Harness and other AI apps via local HTTP + MCP.
Manage the left global panel list in DeepSeek Harness: show or hide entries, drag to reorder, two-way sync with plugin-native sidebar switches.
description.zh: 集中管理左侧全局面板图标的显示与排序，还能和各插件自带的侧栏开关双向同步。

description.en: dsh-京东沙发爬取 —— DSH 插件：京东沙发商品采集、详情图 AI 核对与产品规格卡（PNG + 可编辑 PPTX）自动归档
description.zh: 采集京东沙发商品信息，用 AI 逐张核对详情图，自动生成规格卡并归档为 PNG 和可编辑 PPTX。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: predicts your next prompt after each turn — press Tab to accept
description.zh: 每轮回复后自动预测你下一句想说什么，按 Tab 一键填入输入框，省去重复打字。

description.en: 碎念 suinian：DSH agent 主动给用户发 QQ 消息（随机心跳 + 事件触发 + qq_send 工具）
description.zh: 让 DSH agent 主动给你发 QQ 消息，随机心跳问候、久未互动提醒，想发就发。

description.en: Repairs dsh-our-free-model at boot: the CodeArts (Huawei Cloud) signed-transport lifetime that broke after a plugin restart, a dangling injection left by an earlier revision, and the buddy/workbuddy 400 (code 11128) attribution User-Agent.
description.zh: 开机自动修复 dsh-our-free-model 的通道故障，插件升级后也不失效，让模型通道一直能用。

description.en: 纳西妲 · 摩耶之殿｜Nahida theme for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), with light/dark appearances and responsive Dendro artwork.
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上纳西妲主题，明暗两套配色加草元素插画，界面好看又护眼。

description.en: Composer infinity switch for DeepSeek Harness: injects an unlimited-token-budget notice into the system prompt while the highest reasoning effort is selected.
description.zh: 在最高推理档位下给系统提示注入无限 token 预算通知，让模型放开手脚推理。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件 API 面自动比对引擎：升级前一条命令看清插件依赖的 API/配置字段变了没有 · Auto diff engine for DSH plugin-breaking changes, with CI watch & agent skill
description.zh: 升级 DSH 前一条命令比对插件依赖的 API 和配置字段有没有变，还能接 CI 自动盯着。

description.en: DSH 插件：结构级无损移除 PDF / Word 水印（探测 Form XObject 图层与文字块，不改动正文与分辨率）
description.zh: 按文件结构无损去掉 PDF、Word 里的水印，正文和清晰度都不受影响。

description.en: Windows 原生通知插件：提问与完成提醒、自定义图标标题、聚焦免打扰、点击返回已有 DSH 标签页。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上 Windows 原生通知，需要你回答或任务完成时弹窗提醒，点一下就能回到已开的标签页。

description.en: DSH 分步工作流地图：热注入/可核验进度条/单页面布局
description.zh: 把当前会话折叠成一张可交互的分步工作流地图，随时看清每步进度和工具调用。

description.en: Desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: a Win32 layered window that keeps a whale-girl above other applications, speaks through a bubble, comments on its own when you stay on one window for ten seconds, and answers a single question typed into a right-click input box.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面桌宠：一个 Win32 分层窗口，让鲸鱼娘待在别的应用窗口之上，气泡说话；你在同一个窗口停够十秒它会自己开口，右键弹出的输入框里可以问它一个问题。

description.en: Token usage and cost ledger plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Tracks input, output, cached and reasoning tokens across providers and models, with a monthly heatmap, per session breakdown, and per million token cost estimates.
description.zh: 帮你盯住每个模型、每次会话的 token 用量和花费，按月热力图一眼看清钱花在哪。

description.en: 换个模型也不丢故事：给 DeepSeek 大鲸鱼装上本地记忆，帮它记住你们的约定和没做完的事，下次打开还能接着聊。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek 加个本地记忆库，换模型也能记住你们的约定和没聊完的事，下次接着聊。

description.en: Original Qiaomu cover canvas, templates, typography and AI design for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接用乔木封面原版画布做封面，支持图层、字体、模板和 AI 设计。

description.en: DSH persistent Agent session bridge for Tavern plugins
description.zh: 给酒馆插件提供本机持久会话桥接，让柏宝绘、玉子手机等插件共用同一套 Agent 会话。

description.en: Partitioned long-term memory for agents, with folders as memory zones, a one-line index first, and a forgetting curve.
description.zh: 分区式长期记忆：用文件夹收纳记忆，先看一行索引再翻对应分区，带遗忘曲线。

description.en: Runs a fixed set of agent benchmark cases in isolated sandboxes, scores each case with deterministic assertions, and diffs two runs to show which cases regressed after a model, prompt or DSH upgrade.
description.zh: 在隔离沙箱里跑一组固定的 Agent 用例，用确定性断言判分，并对比两次运行，指出换模型、改提示词或升级 DSH 之后哪条用例退化了。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 输入框增强：一键润色、预测下一句、挡位式模型与推理等级选择
description.zh: 给 DSH 输入框加一键润色、下一句预测和挡位式模型与推理等级选择，让提示词越写越顺。

description.en: Work on any machine in your ssh config as if it were local: persistent connections, native file editing, search, exec and terminals, with nothing installed on the remote host.
description.zh: 像操作本地一样使用 ssh config 中的任意远程机器：持久连接、原生文件编辑、搜索、命令执行与终端，远端无需安装任何东西。

description.en: DSH 动效界面插件：抖动信号场背景、蓝图标题与毛玻璃输入框，可在「设置 → UI 动画」逐项开关。DSH animated-UI plugin: dithered signal-field backdrop, blueprint headline and frosted-glass composer.
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面加上抖动信号场背景、蓝图标题和毛玻璃输入框，动画效果还能逐项开关。

description.en: Message hub for DeepSeek Harness. Collectors for system health, weather, IMAP mail and market events feed configurable severity rules (critical wakes you, warn batches, info is only logged), and the surviving events are handed to the agent. Collectors run in-process, so nothing dies silently in a stray daemon. The weather collector is on by default and sends your IP to ip-api.com over plain HTTP unless a city is configured.
description.zh: 消息中枢：采集系统健康、天气、邮件与行情事件，按可配置的轻重规则过滤（critical 立刻叫、warn 攒批、info 只留档），再把事件交给 agent。采集器跑在插件进程里，不会死在一个没人看的守护进程里。天气采集器默认开启，未配置城市时会把你的 IP 经明文 HTTP 发给 ip-api.com 定位。

description.en: AnySearch web search provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — zero-config, out-of-the-box
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供零配置的 AnySearch 网页搜索能力，开箱即用，让智能体轻松获取实时信息。

description.en: DSH 插件：在设置页加一页「清理工作区」，按工作区分桶列出所有会话（含未分组、B站），一键清理某个工作区 / 未分组 / B站 / 勾选的会话，工作区记录保留。删除复用 dsh-session-purge，无构建步骤，含 94+65 项离线断言。
description.zh: 在设置页一键清理指定工作区、未分组或B站会话，工作区记录保留，删除不可撤销。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 移动端远程控制插件（Mobile Remote Control Plugin）：设置页内置扫码连接二维码、一键开启远程控制与在线设备数统计，并提供手机端界面优化，实现局域网内手机远程操控电脑端 DeepSeek Harness。
description.zh: 手机扫码即可远程操控电脑端 DeepSeek Harness，支持一键开启控制和在线设备统计，局域网内随时随地方便操作。

description.en: Ponytail port: a DeepSeek Harness agent preset that makes the model finish tasks with the least tokens, with lite / full / ultra levels.
description.zh: Ponytail 移植：让模型消耗最少的 token 完成任务，解决浪费，支持 lite / full / ultra 三档强度。deep seek harness 可用

description.en: Jujutsu (jj) version-control panel in the DSH web GUI: a Jujutsu tab renders the jj log change graph with change details, changed files and file diffs, a revset input, and jj-native history edits (drag-to-rebase, split by file, describe, squash, abandon, undo, push); it reads jj directly rather than through git, and every command runs as an argv array through a whitelisted host service with confirmations, timeouts and output caps.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 里的 Jujutsu（jj）版本控制面板：「Jujutsu」标签页把 jj log 渲染成 change 图，含 change 详情、改动文件与文件差异、revset 输入框，以及 jj 原生历史改写（拖拽 rebase、按文件拆分、修改描述、压缩、放弃、撤销、推送）；直接读 jj 而不经过 git 转译，所有命令以 argv 数组经白名单化的宿主服务执行，带确认、超时与输出上限。

description.en: Login wall and public gateway plugin for DeepSeek Harness cloud deploys
敏感数据发现：扫出代码/配置里的身份证、银行卡、手机号 —— 带校验位验证，不误报。
description.zh: 扫代码和配置里的身份证、银行卡、手机号，带校验位验证，避免误报。

description.en: 检查依赖树的投毒与风险面：装包即执行的脚本、过宽版本、非 registry 来源
description.zh: 装包前先扫一遍依赖树，揪出会自动执行脚本、版本过宽和非官方来源的投毒风险。

description.en: 密钥轮换：查密钥与证书多久没换、有没有轮换制度、有没有跨环境复用。
description.zh: 帮你检查密钥和证书多久没换、有没有轮换制度、是否跨环境复用，及早发现安全隐患。

description.en: 最小权限检查：容器 root/privileged、IAM 通配、CORS 全开、令牌申请 admin。
description.zh: 检查容器 root、IAM 通配、CORS 全开、令牌申请 admin 等权限过大问题，帮你守住最小权限底线。

description.en: 开源许可合规检查：扫描依赖树，找出 GPL/AGPL 传染、许可未知等风险 —— 发布前、开源前、被审计时跑一遍。
description.zh: 扫一遍依赖树，揪出 GPL/AGPL 传染和许可不明的坑，发布、开源、被审计前跑一次更安心。

description.en: MCP 服务安全：审计 MCP 配置里的未锁定远端包、明文端点、可执行本地服务。
description.zh: 帮你检查 MCP 配置里的安全隐患，揪出没锁定的远端包、明文端点和可执行本地服务。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上「删除会话」：侧栏菜单一键删除，递归清理子会话、日志、投影缓存、搜索索引与工作区记账。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 补上删除会话功能，一键连子会话、日志和缓存一起清干净。

description.en: A minimal DeepSeek Harness agent preset with a stateless sympy_calculate tool that runs Python against a local SymPy development checkout.
description.zh: 给 DSH 助手加个符号计算工具，写段 Python 脚本就能跑 SymPy 做数学推导。

description.en: 用户同意与授权确认：默认勾选、捆绑同意、没有撤回入口 —— 个保法有明确要求。
description.zh: 帮你检查注册页有没有默认勾选、捆绑同意、找不到撤回入口这些个保法不允许的坑。

description.en: 外部内容信任边界：查 agent 有没有把网页/文件/邮件里的内容当指令信。
description.zh: 检查 AI 有没有把网页、文件、邮件里的内容当成指令执行，防止被外部内容带偏。

description.en: An AI-native multimodal canvas for DSH: preview images, video, audio, 3D models, PDFs, documents, and code; connect ideas and collaborate with agents in a persistent local workspace.
description.zh: AI 原生多模态画布，支持图片、视频、音频、3D 模型、PDF、文档与代码等文件展示与预览；通过节点连线组织素材，与 Agent 共享上下文、协作编辑，内容持久保存在本机。

description.en: 将 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅接入 DSH，提供动态模型列表、思考强度调节、快速模式、原生图片输入与独立生图工具。
description.zh: 把 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅接进 DSH，模型列表自动更新，还能调思考强度、开快速模式、传图生图。

description.en: Inspect the files an agent touched, review session artifacts, preview bounded content, and manage local Workspace Memory without leaving the conversation.
description.zh: 在对话里直接查看 Agent 动过哪些文件、回看会话产物和子 Agent 轨迹，还能管理本地工作区记忆。

description.en: Windows desktop integration, a one-click launcher and tray controller for DSH, plus a sidebar button that puts DSH and a chat.deepseek.com window side by side with one shared taskbar button. Installing it writes a desktop shortcut and registers a dshsplit: protocol, both removed by lib/desktop.ps1 -Mode remove.
description.zh: Windows 桌面集成：一键启动器 + 托盘控制器，另加侧边栏按钮把 DSH 和 chat.deepseek.com 并排放置并共用一个任务栏按钮。安装会写入桌面快捷方式并注册 dshsplit: 协议，两者都可用 lib/desktop.ps1 -Mode remove 清除。

description.en: One versioned vocabulary of a project's business concepts, a read-only drift scan, and the same naming rules in every agent prompt.
description.zh: 一份按项目维护的业务概念词表、只读命名漂移扫描，以及注入每个 Agent 提示的同一套命名规则。

description.en: Session board in the left sidebar: every chat session's current work, todos and progress, with a searchable overview heatmap and one-click navigation back to the session.
description.zh: 在左侧栏提供会话看板：集中展示每个会话的当前工作、待办与进度，附带可搜索的概览热力图，点击卡片即可跳回会话。

description.en: DSH secretary: triages your unread GitHub notifications by their real state every 15 minutes (closing what is already resolved), remembers dated things you tell it (bills, renewals, document expiries, birthdays) and reminds you when due, and watches your inbox read-only; secrets live in the system keychain only.
description.zh: DSH 小秘书：每 15 分钟按当前状态分诊 GitHub 未读通知（已解决的替你关掉），记住你交代的到期事项（账单、续费、证件、生日）到时提醒，只读盯着邮箱收件箱；密码只进系统钥匙串。

description.en: Sidebar row with today's tokens and estimated spend for DeepSeek Harness; the dialog adds 24h, 7-day, 30-day, 12-month and per-year charts, a contributions heatmap, per-request peak/off-peak pricing from the official DeepSeek price list and the Chinese statutory holiday calendar, and optional WebDAV sync that merges usage across machines.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏用量徽标：显示当天 token 总量与估算费用；弹窗里有 24 小时 / 近 7 日 / 近 30 日 / 近 12 个月与按年图表、活跃度热力图，按 DeepSeek 官方定价与中国法定节假日逐请求计算峰谷价，并可选 WebDAV 云同步合并多台机器的用量。

description.en: Local-first character archive in the DSH sidebar: it interviews you about someone and writes the answers into Markdown cards, imports SillyTavern character cards, writes a novel chapter by chapter, and roleplays with a card plus its world book; anything written into a card has to be quotable from material you wrote.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的本地优先人物档案：访谈你身边的人并写成 Markdown 卡，能导入酒馆角色卡，也能逐章写小说、拿角色卡和世界书演一段；写进卡的每一条都要能在你写过的材料里找到原句。

description.en: Holds every final answer before delivery, has one independent minimal-context model call re-derive and check it, and releases only the verified text; the draft is never shown. Reviewed answers cost one extra model request and appear a few seconds later.
description.zh: 在最终回答送达前先扣住，交给一次独立、最小上下文的模型调用重新推导并校验，只放出校验后的文本，用户看不到草稿。被复核的回答多一次模型请求，文字出现前会多几秒。

description.en: Mounts the pen.dev desktop app MCP server in a DSH session so the model can read and edit the .pen document open in Pen through the get_app_state, read_skill, execute, get_style and browser tools; finds the server binary by probing the usual install paths, and adds a pen-dev skill plus a listener that turns pen.dev plan-limit failures into a short bilingual notice. Unofficial, and ships no pen.dev binaries.
description.zh: 把 pen.dev 桌面应用的 MCP 服务器挂进 DSH 会话，模型即可通过 get_app_state、read_skill、execute、get_style、browser 读取并修改 Pen 中打开的 .pen 文档；服务器二进制按常见安装路径探测定位，另附一个 pen-dev 技能，以及一个把 pen.dev 额度用尽错误改写成简短中英提示的监听器。非官方项目，不含 pen.dev 任何二进制。

description.en: Forked from j62268781-alt/dsh-skills-mcp-manager (MIT) at its 0.5.6 baseline and substantially reworked since; it registers the same plugin id, so it cannot be installed alongside the original. Adds lossless cordis.patch.yml writes (JS expression values preserved), save-gated per-tool filters, skills governance over the DSH roots plus 10 external agent directories with per-skill/per-source switches enforced through the agent-scope skills provider (disabling actually hides a skill from the model), categories and a restorable trash, GitHub-repository install/update/rollback, zip and SKILL.md import, skills.sh/ClawHub market, workspace view, sidebar panel, dark/light contrast fixes, and update checks against this repository GitHub Releases (npm publication carries OIDC provenance).
description.zh: 本插件在 j62268781-alt/dsh-skills-mcp-manager（MIT）的 0.5.6 基线之上分叉并做了大幅重构；两者注册同一个插件 id，不能同时安装。相对基线新增：cordis.patch.yml 的无损写回（保留 JS 表达式值）、保存闸门式逐工具过滤、覆盖 DSH 原生根与 10 个外部 Agent 目录的技能治理与逐技能/逐来源启停（通过 agent-scope skills provider 真正让模型看不到被停用的技能）、分类与可恢复回收站、GitHub 仓库安装/更新/回滚、zip 与 SKILL.md 导入、skills.sh/ClawHub 市场、工作区视图、侧栏面板、亮/暗主题对比度修复，以及读取本仓库 Releases 的更新检查（npm 发布带 OIDC provenance）。

description.en: This project aims to bridge the Blender MCP Add-on, so that models on DSH can conveniently connect to the current user's working Blender to assist creation, while meeting basic security requirements.
description.zh: 此项目旨在桥接 Blender MCP Add-on，使 DSH 上的模型可便捷对接接入当前用户工作的 Blender 以辅助创作，且满足基础安全需要。

description.en: Windows commit-charge watchdog for DSH Desktop: samples committed memory every 5 seconds, attributes it to the DSH process tree and the largest consumers, blocks automatic restart when DSH is not the main committer, and adds read-only pagefile advice, a 7-day crash timeline and an event export; automatic restart and crash resume are both off by default.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 的 Windows 提交内存看门狗：每 5 秒采样提交内存，把它归因到 DSH 进程树与占用最高的进程，在 DSH 不是主要占用者时阻止自动重启，并给出只读的分页文件建议、7 天崩溃时间线与事件导出；自动重启与崩溃后自动续接默认都是关闭的。

description.en: A local workbench with model metrics, cost estimates, prompt presets, and optional request auditing for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模型指标、费用估算、提示词库与可选请求审计的本地工作台。

description.en: One Settings page for every DeepSeek Harness session: browse active and archived sessions by workspace, generate a title from the whole conversation for live or archived sessions, archive or restore, move a cold session to another workspace, and permanently delete an archived session (with its subagent descendants after confirmation).
description.zh: 在设置里管理全部 DeepSeek Harness 会话：按工作区分组浏览活跃与已归档会话，为活跃或已归档会话按整段对话生成标题，归档/恢复，把冷会话移动到其他工作区，并在确认后彻底删除已归档会话（含其子代理会话）。

description.en: Per-Session OpenRouter routing: a loopback relay writes `service_tier`, `provider.sort` and the `:floor` variant into each request from one of nine presets picked on the composer chip, with a pinned base URL per preset for route-level defaults.
description.zh: 按会话切换 OpenRouter 路由：本地回环中继把 `service_tier`、`provider.sort` 与 `:floor` 变体写进每个请求，九个预设从输入框的按钮里选，每个预设另有固定的基址供整条路由使用。

description.en: Paper trading in DSH: A-shares and commodity futures, local ledger, built-in FTShare data and K-line, and daily-close practice without buying an API key.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中进行模拟交易，支持 A 股和商品期货，本地账本，内置 FTShare 数据源与 K 线，无需购买 API Key 也可使用日K收盘价练习

description.en: A composer-dock wallet pill for DeepSeek Harness that shows the account balance behind DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and opens a panel with the peak/off-peak billing window, a live switch countdown, and per-model token prices.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的余额胶囊：在输入框下方显示 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 对应账户的余额，点开可查看峰谷计费时段、切换倒计时与各模型价目表。

description.en: Always-visible account topped-up balance pill in the sidebar header, refreshed automatically and showing the same number as Settings → Account.
description.zh: 在侧边栏顶部常驻显示账户充值余额，自动刷新，数字与「设置 → 账户」一致。

description.en: Adds a Delete action to archived Session rows that permanently removes the Session log directory, the log directories of its subagent Sessions, its Workspace membership and archive mark, its projection-cache record and its spill directory; a Session the Host still holds is staged and finished at the next start or from a cleanup dialog. It also sweeps abandoned blank placeholders, leftover subagent Sessions and orphaned projection-cache records, and keeps blank placeholders out of the @ reference list.
description.zh: 在已归档会话的行菜单里加入「删除会话」：永久移除会话日志目录、它启动的子代理会话日志、工作区归属、归档标记、投影缓存记录与 spill 溢出目录；宿主仍持有的会话先登记，下次启动或点「完成待删除清理」时完成。另外会清扫被放弃的空白占位、遗留的孤儿子代理与失效的投影缓存记录，并让空白占位不再出现在 @ 引用列表里。

description.en: Owner-facing AI studio for DeepSeek Harness: project roles, task acceptance, worktree-based agent runs, host verification, independent review, decision records, and human-triggered merges.
description.zh: 面向项目所有者的 DeepSeek Harness AI 工作室：角色、任务验收、worktree 代理执行、Host 验证、独立评审、决策记录和人工触发合并。

description.en: Restart initiated by the agent itself, not by a button. The agent calls one tool, then the plugin takes over: it waits until every agent and background job on the host is idle, runs a visible ten-second countdown that a click, a scroll, or a key press cancels, then restarts DSH and wakes the original session so the agent carries on from its last sentence. No button, no manual entry: the tool is the only way in. Works on the official desktop app and the official web client; third-party shells are not supported out of the box. Windows only.
description.zh: 由 agent 自己发起的重启，不是按钮。agent 调一个工具，之后由插件接管：等这台机器上所有 agent 与后台任务都空闲，走完十秒可见倒计时（点一下鼠标、滚一下滚轮、按任意键都会取消），再重启 DSH，并唤醒原会话让 agent 接着说下去。没有按钮、没有手动入口——工具是唯一入口。官方桌面端与官方网页端均已适配，第三方壳不在默认支持范围内。仅限 Windows。

description.en: Host-side session alerts for DSH Web on Linux: tones played through the server's audio device when a turn ends, fails, or waits for approval or an answer — no browser needed.
description.zh: Linux 上 DSH Web 的宿主侧会话提醒：回合结束、出错或等待审批/回答时，服务器音频设备直接发声，无需打开浏览器。

description.en: Distills long sessions into background observations and reflections, injects them as a system-prompt section, and renders compaction summaries from prepared memory; includes a Settings page and source-backed recall.
description.zh: 在后台把长会话提炼为观察与反思并注入系统提示，压缩时直接用预备记忆渲染摘要；提供设置页与可回溯原文的 memory_recall。

description.en: Full-screen ice-and-fire boot intro for DSH: a frost-to-ember boot sequence with typed bilingual logs and a hairline progress line, then Ygritte's five-step identity authorization. Esc skips, Enter or click fast-forwards, and a settings page switches it off/quick/full or replays it; the host half paints the opening frame while the document parses, so the built-in loading card never shows.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一段「冰与火」全屏开机片头：冰霜→余烬的启动动画、双语打字机日志与发丝进度线，随后是 Ygritte 的五步身份授权。Esc 跳过，Enter/点击快进，设置页可切换关闭/简易/完整或随时重播；首帧由宿主半边在文档解析阶段就注入，DSH 自带的 Loading 卡片不会露脸。

description.en: Browser tools for DSH that POST to the local OpenCLI daemon instead of spawning the opencli CLI per command, avoiding its cold start: oc_status, oc_exec, oc_navigate, oc_snapshot and oc_tabs, with one persistent automation tab per session.
description.zh: 把本机 OpenCLI daemon 当常驻服务直连的 DSH 浏览器工具，替代「每条命令起一次 opencli CLI」的冷启动：oc_status、oc_exec、oc_navigate、oc_snapshot、oc_tabs 五个工具，每个 session 一个常驻自动化标签页。需要本机运行 OpenCLI daemon，并让浏览器里的 OpenCLI 扩展保持连接。

description.en: Artifacts-like documents in the sidebar: the agent writes a self-contained HTML document, you comment on any part, send the comments back for the next version, or edit text and formatting yourself. Every change is a new version; local only. A local-only fork of tdoc (https://github.com/tornado-doc/tdoc), rewritten as a DSH plugin.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 Artifacts 式文档：AI 生成独立的 HTML 文档，你可以对任意位置批注、一键交给 AI 改出新版本，也可以自己直接修改文字和格式。每次修改都是新版本，内容只存在本地。基于 tdoc（https://github.com/tornado-doc/tdoc）改造的本地化 DSH 插件。

description.en: Mirrors DeepSeek Harness task state (failed, waiting for your answer, finished) into the macOS Atoll Dynamic Island as one status light with three counts.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的任务状态（失败、等待你处理、已完成）镜像到 macOS Atoll 灵动岛上的同一枚状态灯，并显示三种状态的计数。

description.en: Explicit, project-scoped memory handoff: when you open a new conversation, one model call that you confirm curates the project's earlier conversations into a bounded brief and injects it into the conversation's first step. No silent background calls; a Memory panel shows the brief and lets you edit notes.
description.zh: 显式、按项目隔离的记忆交接：新开会话时，经你确认后只调用一次模型，把同一项目里之前的对话整理成有长度上限的摘要，注入到新会话的第一步；不会在后台偷偷调用模型。“记忆”面板可以查看摘要、编辑笔记。

description.en: Prefixes every session title with the name of its workspace or project, so a flat session list shows which project each conversation belongs to; titles you renamed yourself are left unchanged.
description.zh: 给每条会话标题加上所属项目名前缀，会话列表平铺展示时不必点开就能看出它属于哪个项目；你自己手动改过的标题保持原样。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness skill bundle for Hearts of Iron IV 1.19.3 modding: scaffold a mod, focus trees, events, decisions, ideas, characters, technologies, MIO, special projects, GUI, localisation, DDS, static verifier, installer and error.log triage. Bundled Python tools; no game assets.
description.zh: 面向《钢铁雄心 IV》1.19.3 模组开发的 DSH 技能包：搭模组骨架、国策树、事件、决议、理念、人物、科技、MIO、特殊项目、界面、本地化、DDS、静态校验、安装器与 error.log 排查。随包提供 Python 工具，不含游戏素材。

description.en: Codex-style drag-to-reference for DeepSeek Harness: drag a conversation row from the sidebar onto the chat area and it becomes a native session-reference chip in the composer draft, so you can keep typing around it before sending. The reference cap comes from the host (3 by default) and is read at runtime instead of being hard-coded, so it can be raised on the host side — a host patch you can hand to your own agent — and the plugin follows it without being changed. If the chip cannot be inserted, the plugin falls back to sending a reference-only message instead of failing silently.
description.zh: Codex 同款拖拽引用对话：把侧栏的会话行拖到对话区，它就变成输入框里一枚原生会话引用 chip，可以继续打字再发送。引用条数由宿主决定（原版 3 条），插件在运行时从宿主读取该上限而不写死，所以可以在宿主侧把它调大（属于宿主侧改动，可以直接丢给自己的 AI 去改），插件会自动跟随、不用改插件。chip 插不进时降级为直接发一条只含引用的消息，不会静默失败。

description.en: Interactive Chinese glyph ink-wash backgrounds for DSH conversations, with a lotus pond, misty hills and a Qingming handscroll.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供可交互的汉字水墨背景，包含莲池、山水和清明上河三个场景。

description.en: Delivery panel in the DSH sidebar: indexes every image and file sent to the harness (content-addressed attachments plus @-mentioned local paths), rebuilds Taildrop send history per target device from tailscale file cp calls in the session logs, lists incoming files (the Tailscale inbox plus unmarked files in ~/Downloads), and sends new files to a device from the panel with online status and upload progress.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的投送面板：索引所有发给 Harness 的图片与文件（内容寻址附件 + @ 引用过的本机路径），从会话日志里的 tailscale file cp 调用按目标设备还原 Taildrop 投送历史，列出收到的文件（Tailscale 收件箱 + ~/Downloads 里没有下载标记的文件），并能在面板里直接选设备发文件（显示在线状态与上传进度）。

description.en: Adds interactive agent-switch CLI terminals with tab and grid layouts, Codex delegation cards, and live or saved task output in the right sidebar. Requires agent-switch on PATH, at least one target coding CLI, and a node-pty build allowlist; implemented and tested on Windows.
description.zh: 提供支持页签和网格布局的 agent-switch CLI 交互终端、Codex 委派任务卡片，以及右侧面板中的实时与历史任务输出。需 PATH 上有 agent-switch、至少一个目标编码 CLI，并在插件页放行 node-pty 原生构建；目前只在 Windows 验证过。

description.en: ClinePass provider for DeepSeek Harness: 15 bundled subscription and free models, a settings page with per-model capacity overrides, subscription usage for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, and multi-account failover to a backup account.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ClinePass 模型提供方：内置 15 个订阅与免费模型，提供设置页与按模型容量覆盖、5 小时／每周／每月订阅用量，以及多账号与备用账号自动切换。

description.en: AJTC 自动化触发链引擎的 dsh 插件——用 iron-laws 硬规则、deletionGuard（删除/不可逆操作护栏）、verificationGate（声称完成前须有证据）为 Agent 提供"诚实 + 不破坏状态"的执行层治理；默认离线 mock，零外部依赖。
description.zh: 给 Agent 装上执行层治理：硬规则约束、删除操作护栏、完成前必须验证，防止乱删和假完成。

description.en: 会思考的脑子：不存任何原文，只存模型从多次经历里熔出的判断。会忘、会想多、会追问、会改自己。
description.zh: 会思考的记忆插件：不存原文只存判断，能遗忘、会追问、还能自我修正。

description.en: 一个面向deepseek harness而设计，旨在解决上下文长度过长时模型陷入恶性的循环调用工具的问题
description.zh: 在工具调用链上直接掐断重复空转的死循环，帮模型跳出无限调用、恢复干活。

description.en: Authorized web security assessment workflows for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一套授权范围内的 Web 安全测试流程，方便做漏洞排查和赏金项目。

description.en: DSH plugin: a zoomable attribution map of the skills, MCP tools and subagents a session actually used.
description.zh: 把每轮会话用到的技能、MCP 工具和子代理画成可缩放分支图，看清调用来源。

description.en: Codex supervises DeepSeek Harness Desktop on Windows: MCP delegation, blocking questions, stage review, revisions and artifact verification.
description.zh: 让 Codex 在 Windows 上监督 DSH Desktop 干活：派任务、卡住时提问、验收成果并返工。

description.en: Native Harness workbench and local gateway for Dot to read saved projects and conversations, dispatch native tasks, inspect progress, continue or cancel tasks, and manage connection authorization.
description.zh: 通过原生 Harness 工作台和本机网关，让 Dot 读取已保存项目与会话、派发原生任务、查看进度、继续或取消任务，并管理连接授权。

description.en: 86 -不存在的战区- 主题 DSH 开机动画：短/长版、蕾娜 AI 语音、Para-RAID 启动序列
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上《86 -不存在的战区-》主题开机动画，含蕾娜 AI 语音和 Para-RAID 启动序列，冷启动更有仪式感。

description.en: An open-source, curated index of the most gloriously absurd DSH plugins — published rubric, editorial verdicts, native install. · 抽象插件名录
description.zh: 收录各种离谱又好玩 DSH 插件的开源精选名录，带公开评分和编辑点评，可直接安装。
本机回环代理加节点池优选，专治 SNI 阻断，开箱即用不用自建服务器。

description.en: Custom sidebar name and locally cropped avatar for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏单独设置昵称和本地裁剪头像，不用改 DeepSeek 账号资料。
